z4_cover_4_5.jpg.note: covers the same pano region as the four zoom-5 tiles above; cbk zoom 4 is 8192 wide, so it is also the half-scale ground truth for a degraded zoom-5 body

z3_edge_bottom.jpg.note: bottom-right tile of a 3328x1664 zoom-3 image; 383 of its 512 rows are black padding, so Google pads short edge tiles rather than returning a true-size body

z3_blank_out_of_range.jpg.note: x=20 is far past the 7-column zoom-3 grid; Google still answers 200 OK with a valid, all-black image/jpeg - which is why an out-of-range grid cannot be detected tile by tile

z5_fover2_4_2.jpg.note: same grid position, one URL parameter apart. y=2 is inside the polar band that fover halves; z5_nofover is byte-identical to what streetviewpixels-pa serves (#73)

z5_nofover_4_2.jpg.note: same grid position, one URL parameter apart. y=2 is inside the polar band that fover halves; z5_nofover is byte-identical to what streetviewpixels-pa serves (#73)

fover.finding: fover=1/2/3 makes CBK serve the polar rows of a zoom-5 grid at 256x256; fover=0 or omitting it does not; onerr is innocent. Isolated by misaugstad on #73.
